summary: Frontend-only iteration 2: covered Emergent Google auth callback, Google sign-in buttons, theme/logo, Block & Report end-to-end, Message alerts (toast + chime + title badge + nav-unread-count), alert-sound-toggle persistence, and regressions (meetup countdown, Enter-to-send, mobile thread-back-link). All targeted flows PASS.

test_results.theme_and_logo: PASS — hero-register-cta bg = rgb(255,176,134); nav logo /logo-mark.png; nav Join button peach.
test_results.auth_callback_bogus: PASS — /auth/callback#session_id=bogus redirects to /register, no runtime overlay, graceful 401 handled.
test_results.auth_callback_cookie: PASS — httpOnly cookie session_token=test_session_ui_fbd02810628f ⇒ /auth/callback redirects to /directory; nav-profile-menu-btn shows 'Neha Verma' with avatar img.
test_results.google_buttons: PASS — reg-google-signin-btn navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>/auth/callback (contains auth%2Fcallback). messages-google-signin-btn and requests-google-signin-btn render on signed-out pages. profile-google-signin-btn present inside signed-in profile menu.
test_results.block_report: PASS — thread-block-btn opens block-report-modal 'Block Aarav?', reasons (spam-or-scam) + report checkbox + confirm. Toast 'Aarav blocked and reported'; redirected to /messages; conversation-item disappears; blocked-list-toggle shows 'Blocked people (1)'; blocked-item + unblock-btn present; directory hides Aarav for Neha; anonymous visitor still sees Aarav; /messages/<aaravId> shows thread-blocked-notice, message-input absent, thread-unblock-btn present. Unblock restores composer and directory visibility. member-card-block-btn on directory card also opens same modal.
test_results.message_alerts: PASS — Ravi→Neha POST /api/conversations/{nehaId} {text}. Within ~2s a sonner toast titled 'Ravi Sharma' with message text and Open action appeared on Neha's /directory tab. Clicking Open navigates to /messages/<raviId>. Within ~5s title gained '(1) ' prefix and nav-unread-count badge showed '1'. When already viewing the thread, incoming messages do NOT toast (verified).
test_results.alert_sound_toggle: PASS — alert-sound-toggle initial aria-pressed=true; click flips to false and localStorage connectme.alertSound.v1='off'; persists across reload.
test_results.regression_requests: PASS — meetup-countdown and contact-reveal present on /requests.
test_results.regression_enter_send: PASS — Enter in message-input sends and bubble appears.

critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/conversations/{id} expects field name 'text' (not 'body') — field naming is consistent in UI, only noted for future API doc clarity.
nav-unread-count / document.title badge updates on polling interval (observed within ~5s). Toast is near-instant. Consider sharing the same source so title updates feel as snappy as the toast.
test_credentials: localStorage profile (Neha / Ravi) from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Google session cookie test_session_ui_fbd02810628f confirmed working via /auth/callback and /api/auth/me.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral messages Ravi→Neha ('Alert ping ...', 'No-toast ...', 'Badge test ...'). Blocked Aarav then unblocked (state restored). alertSound.v1 toggled off then back to default.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-2 flows pass. If reproducing message-alerts title/badge, poll up to ~8s after send (updates arrive via unread polling in ~3-6s). Toast appears via message polling within ~2s. Always use JSON field 'text' when POSTing to /api/conversations/{id}. Remember to unblock after any block test — blocking also auto-declines location requests.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs reproduced in this iteration.
